key_insight: The paper extends decentralized online optimization on Riemannian manifolds to strongly geodesically convex losses and achieves the first logarithmic static regret guarantee in this setting.
engineering_relevance: This provides a principled foundation for distributed learning and control on curved spaces, where communication-constrained agents need provable performance under time-varying online data.
method: Generalize network-error analysis to handle time-varying, decaying step sizes.
Prove O(log T) static regret for decentralized online Riemannian gradient descent under strong g-convexity.
Extend the guarantee to two-point bandit feedback via strong subconvexity of smoothed losses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret bounds—O(log T) versus the usual O(√T)—and states the result is minimax-optimal in the strongly-convex online setting.
watch_item: The guarantees rely on bounded sectional curvature and carefully scheduled step sizes, so practical performance may be sensitive to manifold geometry and network conditions.
paper_title: Decentralized Online Riemannian Optimization for Strongly Geodesically Convex Functions
